asked.item: Why replies land in Message Requests
Can replies be sent to the main inbox instead

verdict.reason: The FAQ says Facebook decides where the message lands, Blotato cannot change it, and suggests using the public reply.

steps.text: When a person has not messaged your Page before, Facebook can put the Page's message in their Message Requests folder instead of their inbox.
Facebook decides where the message lands, and Blotato cannot change it, so you can't make these go to the main inbox.
To help people find the message, use the automation's public reply to tell them to check Message Requests.
